# @canopy/auth-builtin

Canopy's built in app user auth: email and password, magic links, OTP, OAuth, anonymous users and EdDSA access tokens, on Better Auth in the canopy_auth database.

You do not import it: `@canopy/server` loads it when the config uses `builtin()`. Users, sessions and signing keys live in the `canopy_auth` database.

Part of [Canopy](https://github.com/FlazexHQ/Canopy), an open source, self hostable backend platform for MongoDB. Nothing is
published to npm yet: until then, use it from a clone of the repository.

## Install

```bash
bun add @canopy/auth-builtin @canopy/server
```

`pnpm add`, `yarn add` and `npm install` take the same names.

## Use

```ts
import { builtin, defineConfig, env } from "@canopy/config"

export default defineConfig({
  mongodb: { uri: env("MONGODB_URI") },
  masterKey: env.secret("CANOPY_MASTER_KEY"),
  auth: builtin({ emailPassword: true, twoFactor: true, passkeys: true }),
})
```
